data.title: Why bitcoin suffers alongside everything else on bad trading days
data.description: "The Daily Wolf" host Scott Melker joins Yahoo Finance's Julie Hyman at Yahoo Finance's 2026 Invest conference to discuss how bitcoin (BTC-USD) can still be susceptible to falling on risk-off days, all this coming as Nvidia's (NVDA) CEO Jensen Huang resigned.
